title: The Vampire Lestat
author: Anne Rice
summary: Lestat, a vampire turned rock star in the 1980s, tells the story of his life. It runs from a young French nobleman's turning in the eighteenth century to his search for the origins of his kind.
readIf: you like lush, theatrical vampire stories narrated by a vain and charismatic antihero.
skipIf: you want brisk modern horror or find ornate, self-regarding narration tiring.
